per_utterance.speaker: patient
per_utterance.text: I had a car accident. My neck and back hurt a lot for four weeks.

per_utterance.speaker: patient
per_utterance.text: Yes, I had ten physiotherapy sessions, and now I only have occasional back pain.

per_utterance.speaker: doctor
per_utterance.text: Everything looks good. Given your progress, I’d expect you to make a full recovery within six months of the accident.
